_evidence: Family layout for the four 0x300-byte records at 0x6380d8 and the scalars their per-frame routines combine. Record dwords (count 4, stride 0x300): +0x14 is OR-ed across the four records by 0x0041fdd5 (je 0x41fdf8: all zero skips the 0x41fbef call), so it is zero in ~60% of the picks (both outcomes); +0x14 and +0x38 are fild-ed and multiplied by the f64 column 0x622ef8/0x622f10/0x622f28 (a rotation matrix, [-1,1]) and fistp-ed (0x41fbef, 0x41fdd5); +0xc8 is copied into the 32-entry rings by 0x004208f3; +0x174 feeds 0x0041f353 (sums/differences clamped to +-0x80000). 0x0041f353 divides: (A*[0x601350])/[0x601334] and (B*[0x60134c])/[0x601334] with |A|,|B| <= 2^20, [0x601334] in 64..131071 (positive car dimension from 0x4112e3, never 0) and the gains in +-65535 keep |quotient| <= 2^30; (clamp(diff,+-2^19)<<26)/([0x638da4]+[0x638da8]) with each in 0x4000..0x3fffffff (sum >= 2^15) gives |q| <= 2^30; (q3<<25)/[0x638dac] and /[0x638db0] with |q3| <= 2^29 and divisors in 2^24..2^31-1 give |q| <= 2^30: no #DE. 0x0041fdd5 multiplies fistp results by the Q12 gains 0x638d6c..0x638d94 (+-2^12, imul/shrd 12) and clamps the three sums by the unaligned unsigned limits 0x6224ad/0x6224b1/0x6224b5 (0..2^24: both outcomes on both signs). 0x004208f3 uses ring index [0x62291c] in 0..31 (writes [idx*4+0x622940..0x622ac0], 32-entry arrays), window [0x6228b0] in 0..32 (idx-window, +0x20 if negative, stays 0..31) and counter [0x622918] in 0..40 (inc then jle against the window: both ways); a wild index makes the original fault. Everything else read (0x637f40/44, 0x638034/38/44, ring arrays and sums 0x622930..0x62293c) is plain i32.
